system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: pmpranam_resolve_usage_ambiguity and pmpranam_track_grievance_status. For your information, my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_7573, my grievance_id is None, my aadhaar_number is 100020002715, my season is dummy_season_1548.

function.name: pmpranam_track_grievance_status
function.description: Tracks PM-PRANAM grievance status. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: pmpranam_resolve_usage_ambiguity
function.description: Resolves conflicting usage data when purchase records and declared usage don't match. Returns disambiguation details and source conflicts. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify records. Fails if no ambiguity detected.
